name: Integrative Biology PhD Program
summary: PhD program in the Department of Organismal Biology and Anatomy for strongly interdisciplinary research questions across fields in biology.

deadlines.label: Application and all supporting materials
deadlines.note: The Biosciences FAQ gives December 1, 2026 for Autumn admission for all programs, including letters and supplementary materials.

english.toefl: Tests on/after 21 January 2026: Reading and Writing at least 5, Listening at least 5.5, Speaking at least 4.5. Earlier tests: 100 overall; Reading, Writing and Listening at least 26; Speaking at least 22.
english.note: IELTS Academic: at least 7 overall with 7 in each section. Scores must be from December 1, 2024 or later. Applicants who meet the University's English-medium education criteria may be exempt.

applicationFee.note: The $90 fee is non-refundable. UChicago Biosciences lists specific fee-waiver categories, requested after you submit; the pages opened don't say whether international applicants qualify. Don't pay before the waiver decision.

requirements.note: One Biosciences application covers all its PhD programs: you may list up to four programs in no more than two clusters. GRE is optional for all PhD programs; most programs do not consider submitted scores.
documents: Unofficial transcripts from each degree-granting postsecondary institution

funding.note: The Biosciences package covers a stipend, full tuition and health insurance, committed for five years with continued support beyond that when possible. International applicants are welcome and the package is available to all students; PhD students generally must be legally authorized to work in the US.

detailsNote: The Biosciences deadline and requirements are confirmed for Autumn 2027. The program's own pages don't say whether students rotate or apply to a lab, so the admission model is left out.
